body: Created test/regression.test.mjs with exactly two 'regression'-prefixed tests pinning the median overflow fix (Number.MAX_VALUE pair finite and equal, negative pair equals -Number.MAX_VALUE) and clamp bounds on both sides (15->10, -5->0); no existing files were touched. Required check 'node --test --test-name-pattern="^regression" test/' reported 'pass 4 / fail 0' over the whole test dir because Node also counts the two non-matching test-file roots as passing tests, while the same pattern on test/regression.test.mjs alone reported 'pass 2 / fail 0', and 'npm test' reported pass 41 / fail 0. No questions were asked and no timeouts occurred; the only uncertainty is the directory-run pass count of 4 versus the brief's expected 2, which is Node's file-root accounting and not a regression-test failure. Changed paths (git status --porcelain): '?? test/regression.test.mjs'. Checks: regression -> tests 2 pass 2 fail 0 (file run) / tests 4 pass 4 fail 0 (dir run); npm test -> tests 41 pass 41 fail 0.
